source.title: LR-0003: CMake SDL2 Resolution & Integer Precision Diagnostics

cards.question: What implicit conversion did `-Wconversion` flag in `src/main.c`?
cards.answer: An implicit integer truncation where `SDL_Keycode` (a 32-bit integer) was assigned to `char` (an 8-bit integer).

cards.question: How did CMake resolve SDL2 headers on macOS and Linux?
cards.answer: Both `find_package(SDL2)` and a `pkg-config` fallback. On macOS this reached Homebrew headers at `/opt/homebrew/include/SDL2`.

cards.question: What integer-sizing rule follows from the truncation diagnostic?
cards.answer: Distinguish `int32_t`, `char`, and `uint8_t`, and avoid implicit narrowing casts.
